annotations.title: Get AI answers about my brand

description: List recent AI answers to the project's tracked prompts, most important first: the prompt, the model, whether the brand was named and how (recommended, compared, mentioned, warned against, its rank), which brands were named, and which sites were cited. Filters: needs attention, wins, missing (brand not named), competitor_gap (a competitor named, you not), recommended. Use for "where does ChatGPT not mention us?" or "show answers that recommend competitors"; open one with get_answer. Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).

end_date.description: Exact end date (YYYY-MM-DD), today at the latest

model.description: Only this AI model's answers; leave out for the project's current models

project.description: Project name, domain or id; leave out for the workspace's current project

range.description: Date range, ending today in the project's time zone

start_date.description: Exact start date (YYYY-MM-DD), for example the 1st of a month; use with end_date instead of range
